748.synopsis:

Junichiro Mikimori is one of these players who has now come to live in Sky World. The story begins with Junichiro on Altaria Island. There, he encounters an all-female guild and befriends two of its members. Together, they decide to leave Altaria Island and journey to the highest point of the world: Aion Island, in hopes of being able to find a way back to the real world.

1260.synopsis:

But, he decided to participate in club activities that he hadn’t done until now, and so his high school life changed into something stormy and full of drama. He joined the one where he played modern games – in short, the game club. Kishimine was supported by the beautiful student council head and a pe*verted teacher, and he displayed unexpected talent. Now the curtain has been raised on the exciting gaming life of an ordinary boy.

2284.synopsis:
Two women visit Dong Fang Ao’s home. Both women claim to be his betrothed. The first woman wants to break off their betrothal but she lost the betrothal gift. The second woman is holding the betrothal gift and demands Dong Fang Ao to marry her.
Dong Fang Ao keeps both women as guests in his home to find out who is his real betrothed. He is curious about the secretive Cao Zi Yun. If she is his real betrothed then he wants to keep her by his side forever. But her secret is capable of separating them forever.

3564.synopsis: The story is about friendship and love, deception and betrayal, ambition and lust for power. 4076.synopsis:

Unexpectedly, the server does not shut down and Momonga is stuck in a skeleton avatar in another world. “The powerful Overlord” needs now to discover the new world and face the continuous challenges that arise.
Having no parents, friends, or place in society, this ordinary man decides to take over the new world the game has become.

In this current age, Celestial Daoism is in prosperity, tens of thousands of Divine techniques shake the Heavens, numerous mortals strive to become Celestials, and millions of sinners walk the Earth. The Prince Heir of the kingdom East Yue Wu Wu Yu, obtains the legacy of the Battle Celestial of the East in the direst of situations to sweep across the Earth and rebel against the Heavens!

23276.synopsis:
With his engagement at hand, the most terrifying and legendary person of the legal world, Fu Huai’an, returns with a son.

She says, “Because I cannot watch idly as Wen Moshen’s woman enters an engagement with you.” 
With a cigarette in Fu Huai’an’s mouth, he crosses his legs. Across the light cloud of smoke, he squints his eyes—watching as Lin Nuan’s slim arms wrap around his neck; he feels stirred.

The world of sword and magic where the hero and the demon king fight. Fell — a demon girl, sets foot on the land where humans live with her master the demon king, with a purpose of establishing a friendly relationship with them.
Under such circumstances, despite possessing an extraordinary power as a demon race, Fell is continuously being pushed around by the humans around her.
Later in the distant future, the diary that Fell wrote during that time will be found in the deepest level of the biggest dungeon in the world, and become a controversy. There are those who call it the holy scripture, while the others call it the forbidden book.

25324.synopsis: Accused of being a witch and a mu*derer, Evony’s imprisoned. “Since I’ve listened to your preaching, let’s hurry up and discuss it with our bodies,” the too serious math teacher Tachibana and ‘the one who has shown outstanding talent since the start of the school’ (Even though he is the son of a Yakuza boss) Jinguuji. Xiang Shaoyun is the young master of an influential and powerful sect and is blessed with an extreme latent talent in martial cultivation. From talent comes confidence, and from confidence comes a declaration to give all the so-called geniuses a head start of ten years before catching up to them.
Ten years later, Xiang Shaoyun appears at a tiny sect of a tiny town. Betrayed and disgraced by his own sect, he is penniless and powerless, his cultivation level lower than his peers’ due to the ten-year vow. Now to reclaim the glory he once had, he must climb to the top from the very bottom.

29164.synopsis:
Xie Yang struggled in the post-apocalyptic world for many years until he was too tired to go on. Then he transmigrated into a young adult entertainment circle novel where the protagonists have easy, sweet, and satisfying lives.

Xia Fengguang was forced to transmigrate into several novels.

In the fantasy novel, the female lead went from being a useless daughter of a second wife to a cultivating genius that is only seen once every thousand years while the male lead was the demon king who is cold to everyone but warm to only one person… 
As for her, she is the male lead’s fiancee who is a great beauty and has a great family background, but no matter which world she is in, she will never receive the male lead’s affection. Xia Fengguang finds this laughable. A genius who doesn’t get along with society, the enemy country’s emperor who has a poisonous tongue, a playboy crown prince, a medical sage who appears serious on the outside but is frivolous inside… Aren’t all these men already more interesting than the male lead?

35820.synopsis:
Book 1
On the day he received the Easter Egg, Lin Jue’s entire life changed. That nightmarish night, everyone in the school became zombies apart from the thirteen who had received an easter egg. It wasn’t because of a deadly virus, but rather a cruel game. Unable to leave the school, they were able to find a bargaining chip for life in the plaza. The prowling hunters in the dark were not the most fearsome opponents, the hidden Judas in the survivors was the most deadly. As everyone died one by one, the survivors struggled, waiting for dawn.
Book 2
It was a nightmare- in a sealed off university campus, the thirteen who received easter eggs were trapped and forced to fight for the sake of seeing the next sunrise. The Judas hidden among the players, the enemies that surrounded them on all fronts, the companions that were ready to turn against each other… 
When Lin Jue woke up on his dormitory bed, there were no wounds on his body; everything from the previous night had just seemed like a dream. But Lilith was still giving out her easter eggs, and Song Hanzhang and Lu Ren were already there. The second round was just about to start. It turned out that all of it, all of it was real.
Book 3
“It means that the world we are in now is fake.” That one sentence from Song Hanzhang woke Lin Jue up from the joy he felt from surviving the second round.
From the moment they received the easter eggs, they had stopped existing in the world of men, and been made to struggle to survive in an endless game. The zombies of the first round, the insects of the second round; every round resulted in piles of casualties in this dangerous world. And in the third round… they were faced with an unprecedented, terrifying crisis.
A team from 2002 and a team from 2022 began a battle of life and death with Lin Jue and the others from the 2012 team. Only one could survive, so who would be the real winner?
associated_names: The Lucky Egg Game [Official EN Title]

36332.synopsis:
As an illegitimate daughter, Wei Yiyi took the blame from her family after witnessing her husband have an affair with her sister, all because she failed to get pregnant; The family even asked her to get divorce and let her pregnant sister marry her husband!
But this time, Wei Yiyi didn’t give in cowardly, “I will not get divorce, I will make your grandchild bear the name of a bastard like I do!”
But for making Yiyi be willing to divorce, her family made trouble in her company and framed her to be third person in the marriage. How ridiculous!
Facing with these accusations, Lin Tianyuan, the brother of her husband, stand up for her: “Mr. Wei, if you don’t want your company to go bankrupt, get the hell out of here! ”
As Lin Tianyuan came closer and closer, she tried to keep distance with him: “I am your sister-in-law, don’t you think your behavior is really inapproriate?”  “Dont worry,  soon you won’t be.”

38124.synopsis:
Wen Xin transmigrated into a lucky koi novel set in the entertainment world as the female supporting character who served as a contrasting image for the female lead.

Gradually, she grew jealous of the female lead – the classic vicious second female lead setting.
However, as a reader with the omnipotent view, Wen Xin knew that it wasn’t that the female supporting character didn’t have good fortune; it was just that her good fortune came from her cats. The female supporting character had five cats, each which seemed ordinary but were actually transmigrated into by big-shots of various spheres.
As long as she took good care of these five big shots, the life that awaited her would be a breeze! But the Wen Xin in the story had no idea. She whose mind was only filled with thoughts of making it big neutered bigshot #1, disdained bigshot #2 for eating too much, and threw the newly born bigshot#4 into the tr*sh can.
Afterwards, the bigshots regained their human form and formed an alliance. In one night, Wen Xin (in the novel) went bankrupt, became the most hated person on the internet, and lost her reputation. After transmigrating into the novel, Wen Xin expressed that although she supported neutering the cat, that didn’t mean that she wanted to experience the same fate! Thus, Wen Xin decided to save herself. First, she would start with canceling the neutering surgery for Bigshot #1….

39148.synopsis:
After death, Gu Jin realized the child, whom she had fed only once in the past, was the only person who gave her proper burial and avenged her by any means. Once she’s reborn, she found him when he was being bullied. And despite objections, Gu Jin took this malnourished child under her care with help from the dimension in her possession. However, never did she expect she would lead him astray… 
Many years later, Gu Jin can’t help gritting her teeth as she is watching the elegant and handsome man on TV. He has grown up to be a successful and powerful businessman who is outwardly kind but inwardly ruthless. Most unexpectedly, he has turned into a man who is domineering and protective of her.

40940.synopsis:
When he was young, Xiao Yu’an wore a white shirt and rescued a child from a tree.
The child’s hands were sticky with sugar water from the melted peppermint popsicle he’d been eating, and he left a five-fingered imprint on the front of Xiao Yu’an’s shirt.
“This is a stamp,” the child declared. “It means you’re my gege now.”
When he was young, Ming Shu had to climb up and up and up in a tall tree in order to see the gege in the neighbors’ yard.
He wanted to quickly grow big and tall, so he wouldn’t need to climb any more trees. So he would be able to turn around, at any time, and see the gege from the Xiao family.
“You don’t need to wait for me,” he said. “Let me chase you. Let me make you my guiding light.”

41196.synopsis:
The Demon King was defeated. The world was at peace. And so Adventurers were losing their jobs.
And though Theodore was the backbone of the Hero’s party, and worked as a choreman who would take any jobs, he was not immune to this change.
“I have enough money, so maybe I’ll just live a slow life in the countryside.”
Theodore thought. But then his old friend the guild master said,

I was slain by the husband I cherished with all my heart, pierced by the blade wielded by my own disciple. In my final moments, as my breath ebbed away, Matthias’ voice caressed my ear gently. “Teacher, may your next life know no regrets.”

Wait for me, Matthias. I am on my way to you, here and now.

79596.synopsis:

From his royal corpse puppet to the leader of the Flower Immortal Sect of the High Mountains, they are all men who have loved him.

Big Chi Huo: Let go of this fish.
Small Chi Huo: I can let him go, but you must stay.
Big Chi Huo: Little brat, these tricks of yours to tease men are all leftovers from me.

82156.synopsis:

82412.synopsis:
Tu Ran accidentally transmigrated into a different world where technology coexists with supernatural beings, two worlds on the brink of merging. Before transmigrating, she was a quiet and gentle girl.
After transmigrating, she carried a machine gun, tossed grenades, chased after aliens that were running amok, and was even called a heartless female demon.
In this world, Tu Ran just wants to survive, but her original identity doesn’t allow it. While everyone else avoids the aliens, their “s**cide squad” has to mingle with them on the Threshold every day. A slight misstep could turn them into food for the aliens… 
As she keeps surviving, Tu Ran accidentally discovers that the inner cores of these aliens are extraordinary. Eating them grants her certain abilities of the aliens.
And this secret hasn’t been discovered by other humans from the different world yet! Hehehe, Tu Ran is ecstatic. Since that’s the case, she’ll temporarily stay in this other world and develop superpowers.
#NoRomance

82668.synopsis:
I think it’s common for anyone to get tired of the reality of just working all the time once the fun student life is over. While envying those who have the luxury to enjoy romance, I spend my days repeating the cycle of taking a bath, drinking, eating, and sleeping once work is done. It’s normal to sometimes wonder why I’m just constantly being scolded and can’t muster any motivation for this kind of life.
That’s the kind of life I’ve been living, and what caught my eye was a commercial for a new VRMMO game. It’s a capsule type, with the basic physical abilities as the foundation, and it’s cutting-edge with all five senses, so much so that the price almost wipes out my savings.
However, the rare items I could acquire can be converted into real money, so I quit my job decisively and went ahead to purchase the main unit, pouring almost all my savings into it. I think my decision at that time wasn’t wrong, yeah.
But still… Why am I so famous?

84460.synopsis:
Shi Tingyu is a young artist with a bit of fame. She suddenly finds herself transported to the 1970s, becoming the daughter of a weapons researcher. Just as she’s about to enjoy her new life, she faces the dilemma of her parents being reported and sent away.
Her parents, not wanting her to suffer, quickly arrange for her to go on a blind date. She acknowledges she can’t endure hardship, so she agrees to the blind date. After all, soldiers exude a certain righteousness and spirit, so she doesn’t feel it’s a loss.
Little does she know, the military officer she meets is an absolute embodiment of pure, stern authority.
Later, she follows him to his military post, and the entire family compound buzzes with the news.
“Did you hear? The perpetually single Lu Weiguo brought back a beautiful wife.”
Those who had previously been on blind dates with Lu Weiguo, numbers one, two, and three, now felt guilty.
They regretted not choosing Lu Weiguo, thinking such a wonderful flower had fallen into a pile of cow dung.
Soon, everyone realized that while Lu Weiguo seemed stern, he was incredibly caring.
The family compound’s gossip changed again.
“Lu Weiguo is kind to his wife and a reliable man. His wife has landed in a blessing.”
Suddenly, Shi Tingyu became the envy of everyone.
Later, as the four-person group stepped down, more and more news circulated around the family compound.
But somehow, all the news kept circling back to the exceptional wife, Shi Tingyu.
“Did you hear? Old Li’s kid got into college!”
“So what? Lu Weiguo’s wife has been hired as a university professor.”
“Did you hear? Old Wang’s family started a business and made quite a bit of money.”
“So what? I heard Lu Weiguo’s wife sold a painting for a substantial sum.”
“Did you hear?…”
From then on, Shi Tingyu became the perfect military wife everyone in the family compound envied and looked up to.
Upon hearing these rumors, Lu Weiguo…
associated_names: 七零军婚：随军后她风靡家属院

85740.synopsis:
On New Year’s Eve, the city’s most cheerful romantic receives an unexpected ticket from a traffic police officer he’s never encountered before.
Featuring a genuine, seductive shou and a stoic, pretend gong.
“For you, I would brave fire and water, from birth to death.”

85996.synopsis:
One-line summary: Chasing the wife to the crematorium (making an effort to attract someone who has become indifferent), the female lead doesn’t look back, the second male lead takes the position.
Synopsis:
To repay the kindness of the older generation, Su Mu crossed into a female-dominated world and became a live-in daughter-in-law of the Yan family, single-handedly saving the Yan family from fire and water.
But her husband, Yan Jiyue, the eldest son of the Yan family, treated her with sarcasm and never showed her a good face.
He even had his eyes on another woman.
It wasn’t until after Su Mu’s death that this pampered and arrogant young master shed a few fake tears and pretended to want to die for love.
Su Mu expressed her disdain.
This life’s kindness was enough. If there was a next life, she would definitely kick Yan Jiyue away.
She also wanted to embrace Xie Yi, who had silently stayed by her side in her previous life and committed su*cide by taking poison after her death.
Who knew that the heavens would be so kind as to allow her to be reborn, returning to the time when she had just married into the Yan family.
Su Mu glanced at the Yan eldest son, who still spoke coldly to her, and threw a divorce letter in front of him.
“Let’s divorce!”
—–
Yan Jiyue never imagined that he would be reborn. He happily went to find Su Mu, wanting to make up for the mistakes he had made in his ignorant youth.
Wasn’t the reason the heavens allowed him to be reborn to let him reconcile with Su Mu?
But when he pushed open the door to Su Mu’s room, the person lying on the bed was another man.
Su Mu’s personal attendant, Xie Yi.
Yan Jiyue hated him so much that his teeth itched. In front of Su Mu, Xie Yi was a gentle and considerate whisperer of sweet nothings, but in reality, he was vicious-hearted and deliberately sabotaged their husband and wife relationship.
In the previous life, it was he who secretly hid in Su Mu’s coffin and committed su*cide, stealing a step ahead of him to be buried with Su Mu.
Yan Jiyue’s eyes were filled with hatred as he cursed, “What kind of thing are you? Your background is lowly, what right do you have to occupy Su Mu?”
Xie Yi looked at the sleeping Su Mu and no longer pretended to be a whisperer of sweet nothings.
He proudly stuck out his belly, “I have the right because my belly is capable of giving the Wife-master a daughter.”

88556.synopsis:
[Original Synopsis] 
The Abyss.
A name that evokes dread in the hearts of all—a vast, suffocating void, an endless chasm where nightmares are born and fester.
In this forsaken realm, fear is not merely experienced; it devours. The very environment is a relentless predator, and existence hangs by a thread, forever on the brink of annihilation. This is the Abyss—a grotesque domain where demons and devils revel in deceit, death and destruction, where hope is nothing more than a cruel illusion. In this desolate world, the Abyss is both a source of ultimate terror and Chen Feng’s only chance for survival.
As humanity nears its final days, Chen Feng uncovers a terrifying power—a cursed ability that allows him to commune with the Abyss itself. Through sheer force or blood-soaked sacrifices, he calls forth the horrors that dwell in the depths, bending them to his will.

With an energy storm on the brink of plunging the world into darkness, monstrous beings from other realms are poised to tear through reality, turning the planet into a battleground where humans are no longer the apex predator.
Once, Chen Feng believed in helping others, driven by a sense of compassion that the world repaid with betrayal and suffering. He learned too late that in a world where humanity is mere prey, kindness is a fatal flaw. 
Now, reborn with the bitter wisdom of his past and armed with the cursed power he once failed to fully harness—the power to summon the horrors of the Abyss—Chen Feng will command the darkness, seize dominion, and carve out his empire in the shattered remains of the world…
For he is…
The Abyss Summoner.

90860.synopsis:
Jiang Wu is a wandering soul who has roamed the earth for a thousand years. One day, he finds himself in a body, reincarnated as a historically infamous and deposed emperor who was beheaded after a coup.

That night, Jiang Wu lazily demands humiliating tasks from the fiercely glaring Yin Wuzhi: “Hold me, feed me, and lull me to sleep.”

91116.synopsis:
Zhu Ning, who had been leading the charge against zombies in the apocalypse, found herself transported to a post-apocalyptic world. In this world, 80% of the land was polluted, and humanity was divided into five classes. She ended up as the lowest class, a fifth-class citizen—essentially an unlucky, defective product.
Completely broke, Zhu Ning had no choice but to become a cleaner, sweeping up garbage.
It was said that cleaning jobs in the wasteland paid well and were easy, practically a dream job.
But… why does this cleaning job seem so different from what she expected?
On the mysteriously disappeared Line 1, she encountered mermen in suits carrying briefcases, with fish heads.
At a famous hotpot restaurant, the hotpot itself tried to eat people!
In a haunted house, the furniture moved around at night and even tried to kill the owner.
Even the supposedly warm and healing aquarium was filled with aggressive mermen demanding to reproduce, bloodsucking mechanical jellyfish, and unknown transparent creatures.
She visited a dental clinic, and as soon as she reached out her hand, it started raining teeth.
…
And that wasn’t all. The cleaning company seemed to be hiding a big secret.
The AI might be the mastermind behind everything.
The pharmaceutical companies looked completely shady!
Zhu Ning found herself inexplicably drawn into conflicts, where one wrong move could lead to a short life.
In the wasteland, everyone had eight hundred schemes up their sleeve.
Zhu Ning: Is heaven messing with me?

92140.synopsis:
“You will commit su*cide on the day you graduate high school.”

“You need to become the character that the writer loves the most.”

93420.synopsis: A short story about a couple—a heartthrob who isn’t willing to confess and a genius who goes all out to chase, only to make things even more awkward. It’s filled with awkward moments, humor, and a touch of sweetness.

Chae Beomjun, whose lifelong wish is to die during s*x, never believed in love. He never thought the day would come when he would confess his love.

A man who can’t cultivate and just wants to “lay flat” becomes the chosen partner of a senior martial sister who has no intention of marrying. From that point on, Han Feng embarks on a journey of becoming stronger simply by lying down. While his partner diligently cultivates every day, he spends his time with plants, pets, and soaking up the sun…
Hard work may not guarantee success, but lying flat is definitely easy.

94188.synopsis:
Mujang, the god of the underworld, imprisoned in Mount Dongdae for two thousand eight hundred years as divine punishment.
Bari, the abandoned princess who has been wandering the underworld for ten years, seeking a remedy.
It is said that in order to escape from hell, Bari must give birth to the child of the god of the underworld…

94700.synopsis:
The university semester started, and I sent off my youngest grandson.
I happily sprawled on my bed—finally, peace and quiet!

Oh well, where doesn’t matter as long as I can enjoy my later years.
Just as I was sighing with emotion, a little dumpling rolled over to my feet, whimpering pitifully.
What?
Is it my destiny to spend my life taking care of grandchildren?

97260.synopsis:
I woke up and found myself inside a game world.
With a hundred years’ worth of gold and experience piled up through auto-hunting! I figured I could just ride it out to the ending.

I swear I’m not the mastermind!
I’m just an ordinary necromancer!

99564.synopsis:
After experiencing the hidden world, returnee Lee Taeseong loses most of his memories and returns to the modern era.
To regain his memories, he joins “Tree,” a corporation closely connected to the bizarre.
“The contract period is two years. After that, it will be decided through mutual agreement.”
“And?”
“During that time, I expect Tree to fully support me in recovering my lost memories and finding my family.”
One day, he encounters a crystalline shard that appears to belong to the bizarre.
A shimmering crystal lodged in someone’s chest. Taeseong wasn’t sure why he could suddenly see such things, but one thing was certain—he had to remove it.
And then… he had to swallow it.
Taeseong pried the crystal from the boy’s chest and brought it to his own mouth.
Crunch. Crunch. Gulp.
As soon as he swallowed it, countless scenes flashed through his mind.
They were fragments of his lost memories.

100076.synopsis:
Qian Xia was just an ordinary, hardworking office worker in the 21st century. One night, after another exhausting overtime shift, she was hit by an out-of-control car and died.
But when she opened her eyes again, she found herself in a massive, dark, and damp cave. Panic set in immediately—especially when she realized she was barely covered by a tattered animal-hide bandeau and a ragged skirt.
Wait… Wasn’t she supposed to be dead? How did she end up here?
A sudden spark of realization hit her. She glanced down at the rough animal pelts wrapped around her body. This… Could this be just like the beast world novels she used to read? Had she actually transmigrated into a beast world?!
In those novels, most transmigrated heroines would at least get a powerful fourth- or fifth-rank warrior as their first beast husband. But her? She was an unpopular, weak, and unattractive “female”—yet her first beast husband turned out to be one of the strongest warriors on the entire continent!
In her previous life, she had been too busy working to even date. But in this life? She had barely arrived in the beast world, and she was already pregnant! And so began her chaotic journey of escaping through the beast world… with a baby on the way!
associated_names: Transmigrating to the Beast World: My Beast Husband Is Too Fierce

103404.synopsis:
Gu Qinghuan traveled through time and became a cannon fodder character who died early in a period novel. When she opened her eyes, she found herself married to a madman, with two little brats thrown in as part of the deal. How was she supposed to survive this hellish start?
Gu Qinghuan thought to herself, I have a golden finger. Keeping a so-called crazy husband around to guard the house while training two future little villains? Totally stress-free. I can even enjoy the perks of motherhood without the pain—what a great deal.
But who would have thought that the madman would become more and more clear-headed? Not only that, he even wanted to turn into a wolf and pin her down. As for the children’s identities, they didn’t seem simple either. This family was way too troublesome… Maybe she should just run away?
Xu Huaian said: “Wife, don’t even think about leaving me. When I go crazy, even I’m afraid of myself!”
Gu Qinghuan, did you know? Because of your presence, all the hardships I have endured have been worth it.
associated_names: 七零后妈养萌娃，疯批大佬宠上天

105964.synopsis:
“I’m free! I’ll do whatever I want!” 
When he was five years old, a boy met a fairy who warned him that his position was in danger. 
At this rate, he would be killed—just like his mother. 
Despairing over his fate, the boy was given a single piece of advice from the fairy: abandon his position as the heir of the viscount family. 
From that day on, he secretly learned magic from the fairy while pretending to be incompetent. 
Ten years later, as planned, the boy was officially disinherited—and he set out to pursue his dream. 
With an immense amount of magic power within him, the boy decided to make a living as an adventurer. He used the ancient magic the fairy had taught him. 
However, while they both had deep knowledge of magic, their understanding of common sense was severely lacking.
Even as they wielded slightly unconventional magic, the boy and his fairy companion gained recognition with the support of those around them. 
Eventually, they learned about a great crisis that once befell this world—without realizing that it was deeply connected to the boy’s dream…

However, in the time-leap world, Haruka approaches Ryo. Bewildered by the difference from the life he had led, Ryo decides not to get together with Haruka so that he will not fail this time. However, Haruka’s approach leaves Ryo in a tough spot. ……

[Genre: Family Exile + Rebirth + Space Ability + Famine Survival + Face-slapping + s*umbag Revenge + Wealth Building] 
Having lived another life, Wei Yunlan knew that on the very day Shen Feng took Xue Linglong as his secondary wife, her natal family would be falsely accused by treacherous officials, resulting in their estate being confiscated and their entire household exiled.
This time, she would not foolishly remain in the Shen family, waiting for her family’s grievances to be redressed—only to end up poisoned and mu*dered instead. Nor would she sit idly as Xue Linglong used treasures taken from her dowry to gain favor, eventually aiding the new emperor in ascending the throne.

108268.synopsis:
My name is Chen Qiye. I’m a transmigrator who crossed into this world and joined the Azure Profound Sect nineteen years ago.

The sect master once said I would become the next leader of the Azure Cloud Sect.
My future was destined to be one of proving the Dao and becoming an Emperor, standing at the peak of life.
But just a few days ago, the sect suddenly informed me that I had a fiancée. Ten years ago, she met with a misfortune. From a genius, she became a cripple. She also picked up a mysterious ring. In her recent family test, she was humiliated and tormented. The sect said she was now completely unworthy of me and told me to immediately…

108780.synopsis:
The strongest S-rank explorer, Akizuki Yuito, was suffering from loneliness.

Shen Xian died suddenly due to an accident and transmigrated into an old-school ABO angst novel, becoming the s*umbag Alpha in the story—the one who made her father so angry he had a stroke, drove her mother to take pills, and caused her wife to divorce her. 125932.synopsis:
Jiao Baimei thought she would never dance again in this lifetime and that her long-sealed heart would never open until she met Qian Baimei, a woman who shared her given name but not her surname. Their first meeting, however, was anything but beautiful.

126188.synopsis:
System + Food + Travel + Relaxation + Cool Article
Lin Xi is a veteran homebody who suffers from severe social anxiety and late-stage procrastination.

127212.synopsis:
Masquerade is a global VRMMORPG phenomenon, promising total immersion, no pay-to-win mechanics, no grinding, complete privacy protection, and diverse gameplay!
Horror, mystery, escape, apocalypse, cultivation fantasy… there are no worlds you can’t play, only dungeons you haven’t imagined!

In a shadowy, grotesque world, she was a double agent, dancing between the Eye Spirit Cult and the Exorcist Society, greedily eyeing the spoils of a malevolent god.
In a mechanical era, she first roamed the city of eternal night, traveling from place to place until she finally earned an audience with the supreme mechanical being, “the Prophet,” manipulating factional wars as they uncovered the world’s truth together.
During the “Frenzy Thursday” event, she was crowned with the title of “The Trickster,” taking a final bow with a smile for her defeated rivals, who could only grit their teeth in hatred as she thanked them for their spectacular performance.
The name [Mr. Gray Rabbit] will one day be etched upon the “Supreme Masquerade”!

127980.synopsis:
Lin Chen transmigrated into a “real vs. fake young master” novel.
In the original, the protagonist was upright and outstanding, but after his identity as the fake young master was exposed and he was cast out of the family, he was humiliated and trampled by all the idle heirs in the capital. In the end, he blackened, and half of the great clans of the Imperial Capital went bankrupt because of him.
Lin Chen, expressionless: “Wonderful story. But what does any of this have to do with me, a nameless passerby? I even have to pay my own rent!”
The system said: “Five years later, when the protagonist returns, if you want to keep your job, you’d better hug his thigh tightly and beg him to spare your boss, okay? ^^”
Lin Chen, thoughtful: “You’re right. In order to resign tomorrow from this dishwashing job that pays only 2k a month, I’d better carve out my own way instead!”
The head of the A Family — a billionaire who built a legendary empire in his industry from scratch over thirty years — had only one source of constant worry: his wastrel only son, destined to squander the family fortune the moment he inherited it.
Until one day, a young man who called himself a ‘Professional Real Young Master Substitute’ came knocking.
Lin Chen: “A sense of crisis and competition are always the best motivators for growth.”
Lin Chen: “I suggest you pay me thirty million to be your son for one year. Then tell him he was actually the fake son you picked up by mistake all those years ago. By this time next year, I guarantee he’ll understand that if he doesn’t work hard, not a penny of the family fortune will ever be his!”
The A Family head was moved.
The next day, Lin Chen was welcomed through the gates of the A Family, and their only son was instantly demoted to “fake young master.”
Lin Chen: “Hahaha! Life as a young master, here I come!”
What did it feel like to be kicked down from the clouds into the mud?
The A Family’s son experienced it firsthand. He was bewildered, broken, furious, screaming, mad, then calm, then full of hate — until finally he gritted his teeth and swore to improve himself.
A year later, with a report card of straight A’s in hand, the A Family’s son stormed back home in tears, demanding of his father: “Do you want Lin Chen, or do you want me?!”
The next day, Lin Chen left satisfied — with thirty million in salary and the A Family head’s endless gratitude — faking a terminal illness and disappearing from sight.
The following year, Lin Chen became the long-lost legitimate heir of the B Family, the leading company in another industry.
The third year… the fourth year… the fifth year…
Later on, all the patriarchs of the capital’s great clans shared an unspoken secret they never dared tell their sons:
The “real young master / legitimate eldest son / big brother” whom they had all yearned for, remembered day and night, even cried and begged to see again —
…had simply gone off to another clan, to play the role of their young master instead!
associated_names: 职业真少爷，年薪三千万

128236.synopsis:
Se-hwa is the eldest daughter of Myeonghwa, the most prestigious restaurant group in Nampyeong City. While her father constantly cheats, her mother buries herself in work to keep the family afloat. As Se-hwa takes on more and more responsibility, caring for her siblings and helping at the restaurant, the weight of expectations wears her down. She longs to break free from the life her mother has planned for her, but she always finds herself right back where she started.
Then one day, a marriage proposal arrives for her younger sister. The groom-to-be is Kwon Yoon-hak, the youngest son of Chairman Kwon—a major landowner in Nampyeong City—and the heir to Cheongseonjae. He’s brilliant, a natural entrepreneur, and perfectly handsome, but he’s also a divorcee who returned after just one year of marriage. He’s also Se-hwa’s first love.
When her sister, not wanting the arranged marriage, tries to run off with her boyfriend, Se-hwa seizes the opportunity and takes her place at the blind date.
“So, you’re really serious about getting married?”

And so, the two are bound by a strict prenuptial agreement. When an impatient Se-hwa starts to provoke the husband who leaves her untouched, Yoon-hak begins to see his wife in a new light.
***
Her body was a mystery. How could flesh be so soft? It was as if she’d never done a day of work in her life. And that sweet scent of her skin? Surely not all women could be that soft and sweet. Was she really twenty-six?
Yoon-hak flicked the ember from his cigarette, extinguishing it, and snapped the stick in two. Her moans… damn it.
Now he knew. He knew why every time Myeong Se-hwa spoke, it felt like an irritating, tickling thread. So this was his type… a young woman.
He thought he had no s*x drive. He wanted to grab the ankle of the woman who was about to go wash up and do it again. Until the maddening thirst was quenched.
A hollow laugh escaped him, followed by a wave of self-loathing.

133356.synopsis:
I thought that senior was perfect in every way. Turns out he was a gaming addict.
Being next to an addict, have I become one too? He appears before my eyes at all hours.
‘He’s pretty.’
By the time I had such thoughts while looking at those hands that tap keyboards all day, it was already too late.
In front of my senior, I was always just Level 1.
“Are you interested? Want to play together?”

An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth. A gaming addict for a gaming addict. I must reach max level!
And so, at the edge of twenty-one, the third act of Jang Kwon-ju’s life began.
In the form of a gaming addict, no less.
***
“Senior.”
Feeling that now was the right moment after carefully calculating, Kwon-ju cautiously broke the silence.
The only way to make someone who saw him as just another junior develop special interest and deeper affection.

The name that casually dropped from his friendly junior’s lips was more welcome than he could have imagined.
“Where, which server do you play on?”
“Asuka.”
Even better—the same server, as if by fate. Thinking it would be silly to show his excitement too openly, Ji-won carefully pulled down the corners of his mouth that threatened to rise into a smile, and asked:
“Want to add me as a friend?”

134636.synopsis:
This is an imperial court in a time of utter silence, where the emperor’s will is absolute, and his words are law. Everyone walks on eggshells, fearing that a day of imperial favor could be followed by a night of execution.
Xie Ayu, the daughter of a deposed prime minister, survives the ruin of her family. She takes on the name Su Jin and, disguised as a man, enters the government as an official.
To pursue the “bright moon” in her heart, Su Jin becomes a supervising censor under the guidance of the Left Capital Censor-in-Chief, Liu Chaoming. She is determined to right wrongs and remain true to her principles.
However, with Emperor Jingyuan gravely ill, the Crown Prince dead, vassal princes seizing territory, and foreign enemies at the borders, the political situation becomes dangerously unstable.
Due to her bond with the Thirteenth Prince, Zhu Nanxian, Su Jin is pulled into the center of a power struggle. She walks a perilous path, even splitting with her mentor, Liu Chaoming, due to their differing stances.
In this time of crisis, observe how this young censor, a woman who insists on a career in politics and repeatedly puts herself in danger, investigates complex cases, impeaches princes, and punishes corrupt officials. Together with Liu Chaoming, Zhu Nanxian, and Shen Qingyue, she perseveres through ups and downs to find the “bright moon” in her heart and uphold the righteous path.
The path you travel may be blocked by mountains and rivers, and your vision may be obscured by dark clouds. But if you have an open heart, why should you care who stirs up trouble? As long as the “bright moon” in your heart remains, you will one day grasp it.

137964.synopsis:
‘Kali,’ a muscular mercenary standing 175 centimeters tall, dreams of getting married.
She ends up entering the Crown Prince’s “Consort Selection Tournament” and, to her surprise, is chosen as one of the prospective consorts.
Crown Prince Cliff initially picks Kali because she seems sturdy enough to act as a shield for the woman he truly loves. However, he finds himself increasingly drawn to her.
“Your clothes look too tight. Honestly, it might be better if you just take them all off.”
“…Should I? I’ve been feeling suffocated anyway.”
Kali’s face brightened at Cliff’s remark, but the Empress slammed her hand on the table in front of her.
“How dare you! This is the sacred imperial palace! Such words are unacceptable, even from the Crown Prince!”
Cliff locked eyes with the Empress.
“For all we know, a woman like her might have tattoos on her body—or even scars. Shouldn’t I check if the woman who could become my wife has any defects? Isn’t that the whole point of this tournament?”

220140.synopsis:
Wen Qiao is a zombie who looks almost indistinguishable from a human. One day, he is unexpectedly chosen to participate in a survival game spanning multiple worlds.
The system promises extreme challenges, harsh environments, terrifying zombies, and the chance to earn world-class benefits for his homeland.
Wen Qiao’s only problem?
He’s already a zombie.
Extreme temperatures? He has no body heat.
Zombies eating his brains? He is one of them.
Humanity’s survival? Why should a zombie care?
But when the system mentions an enormous variety of resources, including thousands of edible fruits and vegetables and countless kinds of meat, Wen Qiao’s priorities suddenly become very clear.
“I’m in!”
In this supposedly brutal survival game, Wen Qiao discovers something unexpected. Instead of being feared and driven away, he is welcomed by others and frequently receives food and supplies from players across different regions.
For the first time, he experiences the warmth of humanity.
And so, Wen Qiao decides to start over and raise himself as a human.
He wants delicious food, a warm and beautiful home, soft and comfortable clothes, and enough money to spend without worrying.
As survival turns into farming, building, upgrading, and making money, Wen Qiao finds himself caught up with a scheming man from a world undergoing spiritual revival.
Together, these two “red-name” troublemakers set out to survive, grow stronger, make a fortune, and build a life far more comfortable than any apocalypse ought to allow.
